fns.desc: os_exec()'s forked child calls exit(0) after execv() fails, reporting SUCCESS exit status even though the exec failed; a caller using wait_completion (waitpid(pid,&pid_status,0)) cannot detect the exec failure from the child's exit status - should exit with a nonzero status (e.g. exit(1) or _exit(127), matching common exec-failure convention).
